llm_fill fixtures (Q-35 WP-T1; llm_fill_design.md §16; tests/plans/llm_fill_test_plan.md §2-§3)

WHAT
  wd_a/NN-<step>/   tenant A's 7 Workday steps (S-5b): page.html, fields.json (what the generic
                    reader must return), reply.json (the fake model's raw decisions, before guards)
  wd_b/02-...       tenant B's My Information with the REQUIRED "Address Line 2" (the S-5b stop)
  stubs/*.html      single-widget pages for the reader/widget oracles (+ <name>.fields.json)
  shim.js           test-owned Workday widget behaviour (listbox, prompt + categories + search,
                    pills, segmented dates, upload name, entry Delete/Add, Next validation,
                    reveal, counters). Static pages have no pop-ups without it.
  resume_sample.txt, jd_sample.txt   synthetic corpus; the resume HEADER carries the sample
                    contact values on purpose (privacy oracle, review H4)

PROVENANCE
  Every page is GENERATED by tests/llm_fill_pages.py from a spec that copies only the DOM
  structure seen in the S-5b recordings (data-automation-id, aria-*, role, label/for,
  fieldset/legend, entry panels, date sections, prompt pills, drop zone). No recorded HTML,
  text, value, id, screenshot or prompt is copied. Values come from
  tests/fixtures/apply/applicant.sample.yaml; employer -> "Example Employer", posting ->
  "Example Role", requisition -> REQ-0000; Workday question GUIDs are synthetic (5eed...).
  The recordings themselves (pages, prompts, answers, browser profiles with live sessions)
  stay in the Coordinator's session scratchpad and are never committed.

CHANGE A FIXTURE
  Edit tests/llm_fill_pages.py, run `python tests/llm_fill_pages.py`, commit both.
  test_fixtures_are_in_sync_with_their_builder fails on a hand-edited file.

PRIVACY CHECKS (run before every commit)
  python tests/run_tests.py -k llm_fill_fixtures
    (a) generic scan, always: e-mails outside example.com/org, SG phone numbers other than
        the sample's, NRIC-like ids, Workday tenant hosts, requisition ids, binary captures
    (b) owner deny-list: set JOBSCRAPER_FIXTURE_DENYLIST to a file OUTSIDE the repo (one real
        value per line: the owner's names, e-mails, phone, address, postal code, employer
        names, tenant hosts). Never commit that file. Without it the test prints a note.
